scientific_question: Which variable genes and principal axes emerge from declared normalization of observed mouse hematopoietic progenitor read counts, and how strongly do the first axes track original library depth?

source.origin: Observed mouse hematopoietic progenitor Smart-seq2 read counts
source.input: Byte-checked H5AD made from the existing filtered_counts.mtx.gz, cell_qc.tsv and feature_qc.tsv; 1422 retained cells, 40312 endogenous genes, 17332418 nonzero integer read counts. Preserve cell and feature order and original pre-gene-filter endogenous library depth from cell_qc.tsv. The task uses this QC-filtered cohort, not all 1920 GEO count columns.

method.input_statistics: Across all 1422 cells and 40312 input genes, report median filtered read counts per cell and the percentage of positive sparse entries equal to one. These are reads, not UMIs.
method.feature_filter: Select genes detected in at least 10 of the 1422 input cells; retain original feature order.
method.normalization: On eligible genes only, scanpy.pp.normalize_total(target_sum=10000, exclude_highly_expressed=False), then scanpy.pp.log1p once. Keep integer counts unchanged in layers['counts']. The normalization denominator is eligible_gene_reads after the 10-cell filter.
method.hvg: Scanpy 1.12.4 seurat-flavor normalized dispersion, n_bins=20, exactly 2000 HVGs; resolve boundary score ties by ascending feature ID. Report each gene's raw prevalence across all 1422 cells and the median selected-gene prevalence.
method.pca: On exactly those 2000 log-normalized HVGs, centered unscaled one-thread ARPACK PCA with random_state=0 and 31 audit components; publish PC1-30. No depth regression, scaling, UMAP, neighbor graph or clustering. Admit only if adjacent eigenvalue relative gaps through PC30 are at least 1e-5.
method.diagnostics: From the same PCA, report max absolute PC1 gene loading and max absolute Pearson correlation of PC1-5 scores with log1p(original_endogenous_reads). Original pre-gene-filter depth is distinct from the normalization denominator. Round only final two summary values to three decimals, decimal half-even; retain unrounded artifacts.

required_artifacts: answer.json: one id=study record with median_input_reads_per_cell, pct_positive_counts_equal_one, median_hvg_prevalence, pc1_top_abs_load, max_top5_depth_corr

cell_depth.tsv: all 1422 cell IDs, GEO accession, broad sorting gate, original_endogenous_reads, input_filtered_reads, input_detected_genes, eligible_gene_reads, normalization_factor, log_original_depth
gene_hvg.tsv: all 40312 feature IDs, input order, raw prevalence and sum, eligible, native mean/dispersion/normalized_dispersion, rank, selected; null scores for ineligible genes
normalized.h5ad: all cells and eligible genes in order, unchanged sparse integer counts layer, sparse log1p(CP10k) X, IDs and method metadata
pca_scores.tsv: every cell ID and PC1-30; pca_loadings.tsv: exactly 2000 selected feature IDs and PC1-30; pca_variance.tsv: component, eigenvalue, variance_fraction
diagnostics.tsv: signed and absolute PC1-5 depth correlations and sample counts, PC1 max absolute loading and source gene ID

verification.oracle: Read packaged H5AD and run the pinned Scanpy environment; derive private reference from input, not a fixed answer table.
verification.independent_checks: Check source hashes, all ordered IDs, integer count preservation, eligible-gene denominator, every normalized nonzero, full cell/gene prevalence, HVG boundary and selected set, summaries and complete artifact schemas. At reference admission, check score projection, loading orthonormality and covariance/eigenvalue consistency against the centered selected matrix. At grading, compare every row-keyed score, loading, eigenvalue and diagnostic to the admitted reference after jointly aligning each component's score, loading and signed depth correlation. Do not accept independent score-only sign flips or arbitrary rotations under the eigen-gap gate.
negative_mutations: change one count or cell ID
normalize using original, ERCC or HVG-only depth
double-log the matrix or include a gene seen in nine cells
change one boundary HVG or shuffle a PCA score row
flip a loading without its paired score or concentrate one loading vector
use normalization depth for the PCA correlation
submit correct summary fields with corrupt H5AD or TSV artifacts
verification.admission_gates: Measure full remote runtime below 30 minutes, peak memory and repeatability in the pinned environment; derive tight numeric tolerances from repeated native runs. Specify file-size, row, finite-number and verifier-time bounds before packaging.

endpoint_relations.relation: Both diagnostics from one PCA on independent observations; original 4T1 input and computed values are excluded. Provisional workflow adaptation only.
10-cell filter, 2000 HVGs and depth/prevalence diagnostics on observed read counts; source asks for UMI counts and depth-sensitive variance-stabilizing selection. Component only.
Gene filtering and PCA30 only; source also requires a cell-type-colored UMAP PNG. Component only.
Detected-gene counts and numeric distribution only; source also requires violin and strip plot, and existing GSE81682 QC work overlaps. Component only.

limits: No validated benchmark mapping or coverage credit follows from this design.
Smart-seq2 read counts are not UMI observations; broad sorting gates are not fine cell types or donor identities.
Depth and biological gate can covary, so PCA depth correlation is descriptive and no favorable threshold is imposed.
No mitochondrial transcript signal is documented for this source. No mitochondrial, doublet, donor, clustering, UMAP or plot endpoint is claimed.
Independence from every source benchmark study is not certified by question-only metadata; no benchmark fixture, answer or biological input is used.
